recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes the remaining active, implementer-facing stale guidance without editing retired source/media artifacts, generated-looking SVGs, or unrelated suppression metadata.

Current fhir.ini keeps DocumentReference active and lists Media only as a deleted/non-active resource.

FHIR-23568 is already represented on the combined branch, and FHIR-19250 is a separate boundary clarification encountered in the historical trail.
